Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” (father’s mother) as the grandmother on the paternal line, incorrectly naming Louis XV’s mother (Marie Adélaïde of Savoy) instead of Louis, Dauphin’s mother, Marie Leszczyńska. This confusion was prompted by landing on a disambiguation page and not verifying the specific Louis (1729–1765) and his parentage.
